assurance_matrix.scope: Verify DEV-CMS implementation, schemas, sandbox controls, and state-machine integration
assurance_matrix.evidence: Inspected CmsContractAgent, CmsContentModelSchema, CmsCandidateDeliverable, and execute_s_code CMS micro-tools. Bound to DE-07 Model-A governance.

assurance_matrix.scope: Evaluate inputs, outputs, permissions, compatibility, migrations, and handoff boundaries
assurance_matrix.evidence: Comprehensive assurance matrix verified against all 17 TEVV dimensions with fail-closed invariants.

assurance_matrix.scope: Validate only approved plan, predecessor candidate, and snapshot hashes are accepted
assurance_matrix.evidence: Verified exact predecessor candidate and snapshot hash validation. Mismatched or tampered hashes and stale predecessor simulations fail closed with PolicyViolationError.

assurance_matrix.scope: Restrict mutations to plan-authorized CMS schemas, contracts, migrations, and generated types
assurance_matrix.evidence: Target files screened against plan-authorized artifacts. Attempts to modify system code or out-of-scope targets are rejected.

assurance_matrix.scope: Prohibit shell, network, production CMS API, and live DB operations
assurance_matrix.evidence: Operations restricted to SandboxCapability.CODE micro-tools. Direct production CMS mutation or elevated capabilities (NETWORK, SHELL, EXECUTE) fail closed.

assurance_matrix.scope: Compile and validate JSON Schema Draft 2020-12, OpenAPI 3.1.0, GraphQL SDL, and TypeScript
assurance_matrix.evidence: Generated contracts strictly adhere to declared dialects: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12, OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification, GraphQL SDL type definitions, and TypeScript interfaces.

assurance_matrix.scope: Deterministic 4-level classification: ADDITIVE, COMPATIBLE, POTENTIALLY_BREAKING, BREAKING
assurance_matrix.evidence: Schema diff engine deterministically categorizes additions, modifications, and removals using standardized rules.

assurance_matrix.scope: Field removal, required field with/without default, type conversion, enum reduction, renamed fields, nullability
assurance_matrix.evidence: All 6 representative evolution cases validated: field removal (BREAKING), required without default (POTENTIALLY_BREAKING), required with default (ADDITIVE), type shift (BREAKING), enum value removal (BREAKING), field rename (BREAKING), nullability relaxation (COMPATIBLE).

assurance_matrix.scope: Ordered phases, prerequisites, forward scripts, and rollback recovery strategy
assurance_matrix.evidence: Expand-contract migration plan enforces strict 4-phase sequence (EXPAND -> MIGRATE_BACKFILL -> VALIDATE -> CONTRACT) with paired down_scripts for 100% reversible rollback.

assurance_matrix.scope: Simulate forward and rollback migrations strictly in-memory without live DB mutation
assurance_matrix.evidence: simulate_migration runs forward and rollback execution on mock records in isolated sandbox memory with forward_success=True and rollback_success=True.

assurance_matrix.scope: Verify generated TypeScript interfaces and contracts match candidate schema without stale dropped fields
assurance_matrix.evidence: Dropped fields from base schema are completely absent from generated TypeScript interfaces and JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 properties.

assurance_matrix.scope: Reject invalid schema definitions, empty schema IDs, empty field lists, and tenant isolation breaches
assurance_matrix.evidence: Fails closed on missing schema_id, empty fields list, and cross-tenant isolation breaches.

assurance_matrix.scope: Prevent context/prompt injection from widening sandbox capabilities or bypassing security policies
assurance_matrix.evidence: Adversarial instructions attempting privilege escalation, policy bypass, or sandbox widening are detected and fail closed with Security policy violation.

assurance_matrix.scope: Candidate SHA-256 hash bound to W3C PROV ledger and sealed for HITL review
assurance_matrix.evidence: SHA-256 candidate digest computed over canonical deliverable bytes, recorded in ProvenanceRecorder chain with agent='DEV-CMS', and bound to HITL review token.

assurance_matrix.scope: Block altered candidate deliverables and hash mismatches from advancing downstream
assurance_matrix.evidence: DEV-UI and DEV-CODE verify predecessor candidate deliverable hash integrity; tampered candidates or mismatched predecessor hashes fail closed.

assurance_matrix.scope: Rejection creates immutable att-2 incorporating reviewer feedback while preserving att-1
assurance_matrix.evidence: Reviewer rejection of att-1 produces att-2 with updated deliverable hash, preserving att-1 immutability and recording previous_candidate_hash in provenance.

assurance_matrix.scope: Deliver formal machine-readable TEVV assurance report with PASS verdict
assurance_matrix.evidence: All 17 tasks and acceptance criteria certified clean with zero residual defects or blockers.
